GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 800.217 (2 Jan 46) NR
(SCAPIN - 538)
APO 500
2 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT. (Department of Agriculture and Forestry)
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Extension of Fishing Areas Into the Yellow Sea and East China Sea.
1. Reference is made to memorandum from Central Liaison Office dated 22 November 1945, file C. L. O. No. 687 (3.2), to the Administrator, Naval Shipping Control Authority for Japanese Merchant Marine, (SCAJAP), requesting the extension of present authorized fishing areas further into the East China Sea and Yellow Sea.
2. The request for extension of fishing grounds contained in this memorandum is not favorably considered.
3. Available information shows that fullest possible use is not being made at present of the fisheries resources lying within the area currently authorized in reference (a), (b), (c) and (d) above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
